plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Patton SmartNode voice gateway. It reports uptime, interface traffic, per-CPU workload, memory pool usage and temperature probes (enterprise PEN 1768).
name: VoiceGateway

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Current workload of each CPU of the Patton SmartNode in percent (SMARTNODE-MIB cpuWorkloadCurrent).

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total size of each memory pool of the Patton SmartNode in bytes (memTotalBytes; allocated + free when the device does not report it).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Allocated bytes of each memory pool of the Patton SmartNode (memAllocatedBytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free bytes of each memory pool of the Patton SmartNode (memFreeBytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Utilization of each memory pool of the Patton SmartNode, computed at collection as allocated / (allocated + free) * 100. Empty pools are dropped.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Current temperature of each temperature probe of the Patton SmartNode in degrees Celsius (SMARTNODE-MIB currentDegreesCelsius).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
